---
title: "JUTRO pilot: subject vocabulary and pseudowords"
subtitle: "Biology · Polish primary school, grades 5–8 · ZPE teaching materials"
---

```{python}
import yaml
import _lib as L

cfg = yaml.safe_load((L.ROOT / "config" / f"{L.NAME}.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
opis, m41, m42, m5, m6, m7 = (L.metrics(n) for n in
                              ["opis_danych", "ocena_41", "ekstrakcja_42", "llm_5", "pule_6", "pseudoslowa_7"])
czasy = L.metrics("tagowanie_czasy")
ps = L.csv("pseudoslowa.csv")
kand = L.csv("kandydaci.csv")
kand_chg = kand[kand["forma_podstawowa"] != kand["forma_kandydata"]]
n_llm_t3 = int(((kand["kategoria"] == "T3") & kand["kategoria_final"].notna()).sum())
num = lambda v: L.fmt(v)
```

::: {.callout-important title="Status"}
Everything here is a **candidate list** produced by an automatic process on a sample of
`{python} num(opis.get("materialy_cel"))` biology materials (run `{python} L.RUN_NAME`). No list has been validated by
subject or language specialists, and no model label has been checked against human annotation yet.
:::

## Problem

Pupils with a migration background may fail a subject test for two different reasons: weak general Polish, or
missing **subject concepts** despite adequate language. JUTRO aims to separate those barriers with three modules:
recognition of general words against pseudowords, word associations, and matching subject terms to images.

This pilot builds the word material for biology (grades 5–8) from the teaching materials of the Integrated
Educational Platform (ZPE): a pool of subject terms, a pool of general and school vocabulary, concept groups, and
pseudowords for a LexTALE-style test.

## Pipeline

One command runs eight steps. Each step reads the files written by the earlier ones, so a step can be re-run on its
own, and every number on this site is read from a metrics file that a step saved.

```bash
python -m jutro run --config config/biologia_sp.yaml --probka 50   # sample of 50 target materials
python -m jutro run --config config/biologia_sp.yaml               # full corpus
```

### Technical diagram

::: {.column-page-right}

```{python}
from IPython.display import HTML
import _pipeline
HTML(_pipeline.diagram(cfg))
```

:::

Read each row from left to right: what the step reads, what it does, what it writes. A number in a circle says which
step wrote the file. Result files and metrics files are links to the page that shows them. Intermediate files stay
on the machine that ran the pipeline and are not published. The configuration file `config/biologia_sp.yaml`
(subject, school stage, seed, thresholds, model names) is read by every step and is left out of the drawing; the
thresholds quoted in the boxes are taken from it.

### Steps in this run

```{python}
llm_cfg = cfg["llm"]
models = ", ".join(m.replace("claude-", "") for m in llm_cfg["modele_porownywane"])
judge = llm_cfg["model_rozstrzygajacy"].replace("claude-", "")
sm, st = czasy.get("spacy_morfeusz", {}), czasy.get("stanza", {})
dur = lambda d: f"{d['czas_s']:.0f} s" if d.get("czas_s") is not None else "–"
tag_time = " + ".join(x for x in [
    f"{sm['czas_s']:.0f} s spaCy+Morfeusz2" if sm.get("czas_s") else "",
    f"{st['czas_s']:.0f} s Stanza" if st.get("czas_s") else ""] if x) or "–"
rows = [
    ("1 · korpus", f"{num(opis.get('materialy_cel'))} target + {num(opis.get('materialy_kontrast'))} contrast materials; "
                   f"{num(opis.get('slowa_cel'))} + {num(opis.get('slowa_kontrast'))} words", "`opis_danych`, `dobor_materialow`", dur(opis)),
    ("2 · tagowanie", f"{num(sm.get('tokeny'))} tokens tagged; production tagger `{cfg['narzedzia']['tager_produkcyjny']}`; "
                      f"benchmark n = {num(m41.get('n'))}", "`tagowanie_czasy`, `ocena_41`", tag_time),
    ("3 · frekwencje", f"{num(L.metrics('frekwencje_43').get('korpus', {}).get('n_lematow'))} lemmas with corpus and general frequencies",
     "`frekwencje_43`", dur(L.metrics("frekwencje_43"))),
    ("4 · kandydaci", f"{num(m42.get('n_kandydatow'))} candidates ({num(m42.get('n_mwu'))} multiword); TermoPL ran: {num(m42.get('termopl'))}",
     "`ekstrakcja_42`", dur(m42)),
    ("5 · llm", f"{num(m5.get('n_klasyfikowanych'))} candidates labelled by {models}; {num(m5.get('n_rozstrzyganych_opus'))} adjudicated by {judge}",
     "`llm_5`", dur(m5)),
    ("6 · pule", f"{num(m6.get('n_pula_przedmiotowa'))} subject terms, {num(m6.get('n_pula_ogolna'))} general items, "
                 f"{num(m6.get('n_pojec'))} concepts, {num(m6.get('n_zloty'))} worksheet rows", "`pule_6`", dur(m6)),
    ("7 · pseudoslowa", f"{num(m7.get('n_szablonow'))} templates; {num(m7.get('n_zaakceptowanych'))} rows kept "
                        f"({num(ps['pseudoslowo'].nunique())} distinct strings), {num(m7.get('n_odrzuconych'))} rejected", "`pseudoslowa_7`", dur(m7)),
    ("8 · raport", "Polish report and this site", "`raport_8`", "–"),
]
L.table(rows, ["Step", "What it produced", "Metrics file", "Time"], "llll")
```

Times are wall-clock on the machine described under [Reproduce](reproduce.qmd); step 5 is mostly waiting for batch jobs.

## Headline numbers

```{python}
tools = m41.get("narzedzia", {})
prod = cfg["narzedzia"]["tager_produkcyjny"]
best = max(tools.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1].get("lemat_dokladny_wszystkie") or 0, default=(None, {}))
agree = m5.get("zgodnosc_miedzy_modelami", {})
kappa = next(iter((agree.get("kappa") or {}).values()), None)
rows = [
    ("Lemmatisation, exact match, production tagger", f"{num(tools.get(prod, {}).get('lemat_dokladny_wszystkie'))} (`{prod}`, n = {num(m41.get('n'))})"),
    ("Lemmatisation, best tool in the benchmark", f"{num(best[1].get('lemat_dokladny_wszystkie'))} (`{best[0]}`)"),
    ("Candidates after frequency filters", f"{num(m42.get('n_kandydatow'))}, of which {num(m42.get('n_mwu'))} multiword"),
    ("Candidates labelled by the LLMs", f"{num(m5.get('n_klasyfikowanych'))}; agreement between the two models {num(agree.get('prosta'))}, Cohen's κ {num(kappa)}"),
    ("Subject pool (T3)", f"{num(m6.get('n_pula_przedmiotowa'))} terms, of which {num(n_llm_t3)} labelled by the LLMs and the rest by rules only"),
    ("General pool (T1/T2)", num(m6.get("n_pula_ogolna"))),
    ("Concept groups", num(m6.get("n_pojec"))),
    ("Pseudowords kept", f"{num(m7.get('n_zaakceptowanych'))} rows, {num(ps['pseudoslowo'].nunique())} distinct strings"),
    ("API spend for this configuration", f"${m5.get('koszt_usd_dotychczas', 0):.2f}"),
]
L.table(rows, ["Measure", "Value"], "ll")
```

The reference for the lemmatisation benchmark is partly ZPE editors' own base forms and partly a provisional
reference from a language model, so those accuracies are not a gold-standard result. Agreement between models is not
accuracy. Details and all remaining metrics are on the [Results](results.qmd) page.

## Limits

```{python}
uni = ps[ps["metoda"] == "unipseudo"]
lines = [
    "- This is a sample run. Counts and rankings will change on the full corpus.",
    "- The grade of a material is **estimated** from topic keywords; the ZPE catalogue only records the stage (grades 4–8).",
    f"- Only {num(m5.get('n_klasyfikowanych'))} of {num(m42.get('n_kandydatow'))} candidates were labelled by the LLMs. "
    "The pools also contain candidates that carry only the rule-based pre-label; the `label_source` column on the data pages tells them apart.",
    f"- For {num(len(kand_chg))} candidates the language model returned a base form different from the extracted one, "
    f"and for {num(int((kand_chg['forma_podstawowa'].str.split().str.len() != kand_chg['dlugosc']).sum()))} of them with a different "
    "number of words. The statistics in those rows belong to the extracted string (`forma_kandydata`), and the same "
    "`forma_podstawowa` can appear in several rows of a pool. See the [Candidates](candidates.qmd) page.",
    "- The silver standard (ZPE glossaries) is incomplete, so precision@K against it is only useful for comparing methods.",
    "- SUBTLEX-PL is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and is used for comparison metrics only; it does not enter the published lists.",
    "- The UA/RU similarity flag on pseudowords compares against a built-in list of ten transliterated words. It is a placeholder for review by bilingual staff.",
]
if len(uni) and uni["pseudoslowo"].nunique() <= max(10, len(uni) // 10):
    lines.append(f"- **The `unipseudo` pseudowords of this run are not usable**: the {num(len(uni))} rows are copies of "
                 f"{num(uni['pseudoslowo'].nunique())} strings. See the note on the [Pseudowords](pseudowords.qmd) page.")
L.md("\n".join(lines))
```
